deductions.finding: Low-contrast embossed/curl-like surface pattern remains. It is substantially calmer than11 and no longer dominates the different materials, but slightly limits the natural plush impression. Nonblocking finish preference.
Clawd still faces the viewer, so watching intent relies mainly on stool placement and the neighboring action. This remains the previous optional staging limitation; no new pose demand.

Hero and activity groups remain clear, while the leaf game, tiny grip and guest facial details become accents. The reduced image carries the overall world more strongly than every micro-story; no guest enlargement is warranted.

W1.evidence: Against11, bench boards and toolbox have continuous grain and shaped edges, glasses have stable round contours, Clawd has fine soft fabric, and cream moths recover broad soft volume. Tree/stone/foliage retain purposeful structure rather than the same angular network imposed on every material. Low-contrast pattern remains on the hero, recorded as a minor deduction.

W2.evidence: Native and5x actual13 show one solid rounded mitten enclosing the mallet handle and joining a short readable arm. The raised anticipation pose remains; no hollow strap interpretation or required impact pose.

wholeSceneAssessment: The bench/coder remains the clear foreground focus; the tree arch, open curved path, workshop canopy and distant bridge form one continuous park. Warm directional light, contact shading, soft distant detail and foreground foliage blur create depth without obscuring the supporting stories. Material cleanup improves the environment as well as the characters. At880 and1280 the scene feels calmer and more controlled than11 while retaining its lushness.
baselineComparison: 13 keeps11’s corrected companion-eye construction and scene arrangement while restoring the softer contour/material control seen in07. Its bench, toolbox, glasses and Clawd are cleaner than11 in direct native comparisons. The improvement does not require reverting the leaf story, Muse refinement or grip repair.
